notes.title: Kholat nominated for Game Connection Europe Development Awards 2015!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that Kholat has been nominated for Game Connection Europe Development Awards 2015 in the following categories:
- Best ‪Desktop‬ / Downloadable
- Best ‪‎Hardcore‬ Game
- Best ‪‎Indie‬ Game
- Best ‪Story‬ / Story Telling

Moreover we have opportunity to win People's Choice Award. But we need your help. If you like our game please click on the link below and give us a "like". Thanks in advance!

notes.title: NEW LANGUAGES in Patch 1.03!
notes.content:
We’ve been collecting feedback regarding our game for nearly two months since the release. After a short time it was clear to us that Kholat was especially warmly received in Italy and Turkey. We had many requests from the community asking for the localization of the title into those languages, so we have engaged our resources and we’re able to reveal the effects today!

Localization was carried out with the help of Crewals ([url=http://www.crewals.com/tr/] http://www.crewals.com/tr/  [/url]) and FenixTM ([url=http://fenixtm.net/index.php] http://fenixtm.net/index.php  [/url]) - a big thank you to both teams.

Godere / zevk almak!

IMGN.PRO

notes.title: Kholat Patch 1.01
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that today Kholat patch 1.01 is live and available for download now! 

The update includes:
-launch crashes fixes
-stability fixes
-game will not save in Act 3, players with save from Act 3 can continue playing from last save location from Act 2
-key bindings fixed
-invert mouse fixed
-gameplay bugs fixes
-inventory (map, compass, journal) will now properly scale based on user configured camera FOV
-added few missing localization texts

Patch will be available as an update for Steam platform users.

notes.title: Kholat „The Best Screenshot” Competition!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

As we mentioned last week, we have a surprise for you – it is the best screenshot competition! 

The rules:

1.You need to submit new screenshot from Kholat (competition starts 17th of June 2015 11:00 am CET) on our community hub on Steam.

2. Submit it with a title „THE BEST SCREENSHOT COMPETITION” and remember only one screenshot per person will participate in the contest. So take your time to make a really wonderful pic! 

3. We will check all the screenshots named „THE BEST SCREENSHOT COMPETITION” and only the new submissions will be a part of the contest so please do not change the names of the screenshots already submitted on our forum before the start of the competition and absolutely do not use the screenshots that are not made by you.

4. Screenshots with the biggest number of „thumbs up” will win the prizes. If there will be a tie between the screenshots we will choose the winners.

5. Competition will take one week starting today 11:00 am CET, ending 24th of June 2015 11:00 am CET.

Prizes: 

1. Box version of Kholat (including game, CD with original soundtrack, map/poster, a pin), t-shirt, comic book „Prologue”, and more pins.

2. Comic book „Prologue”, t-shirt, pins and digital version of the OST.

3. T-shirt, comic book „Prologue”, pins.

4. T-shirt, pins.

5. T-shirt.

6. Comic book „Prologue”, digital version of the OST.

7. Digital version of the OST.

8. Digital version of the OST.

9. Digital version of the OST.

10. Digital version of the OST.

notes.title: Kholat - win a special box edition!
notes.content:
Kholat – a most terryfying journey of your life starts today!


And we have a very special event for you!

Only today for next 10 hours, you can win something really special! Amazing edition of our game, in special, handcrafted metal box. It is an absolutely limited gem for any collector. There is only couple of metal boxes created for us and they will never be available in regular sales. This rarity could be yours!

This special set contains:

1. Absolutelty unique, handcrafted metal box, created by our friend Grzegorz Beczała at SCRAP ART (https://www.facebook.com/gbsart)
2. DVD Box
3. Game disc
4. CD with soundtrack created by Arkadiusz Reikowski
5. Pin
6. Map/poster
7. T-shirt
8. Burglar cap 
9. 9 Steam codes included in the box for your friends (one of it you will get at midnight release today) 
10. Comic book with a prologue

What will you need to do?

1. Go to our facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/Kholat
2. Like this post
3. Share it on your facebook wall to spread a word about our game and release date.
3. We will pick winner randomly using fanpagekarma.com

Thank you!
